name: Steven W. Fogg
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Seattle, Washington
education: University of Virginia School of Law
about: Steven W. Fogg attended law school and graduated from University of Virginia School of Law in 1989. Steven Fogg began practicing law in 1989.
Steven Fogg is an attorney at Corr Cronin LLP, helping people with Business Litigation issues. Corr Cronin LLP has an office in Seattle, Washington, serving the local community.

Steven Fogg was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
